description: Get the numeric rel_id for a field of type 'rel' (a link). Needed before create/update record when a rel field must be filled in. Pass the form's entity_id and the link field's property_id.

entity_id.description: ID of the form that holds the rel field

property_id.description: ID of the rel-type field (from get_form_fields)

name: get_rel_id
